name: APIVerveWordLexiconAnalyzer
summary: Word Lexicon Analyzer inspects any single word to check linguistic properties including palindromes, isograms, and Scrabble validity.
description:
Word Lexicon Analyzer inspects any single word to check linguistic properties including palindromes, isograms, and Scrabble validity. It identifies anagram potential, alphagram status, and sorted letter forms.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Word Lexicon Analyzer from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
